request.title: Durzo, Emissary of Death
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. This is a still for a cinematic trailer: keep the main subject centred slightly above the middle with a strong silhouette, and keep the lower third darker and uncluttered so a title can sit over it. Scene: the grey Realm of Death and Shadow, mist over black water and dead trees. Durzo stands ready with twin daggers drawn, a violet mark glowing on his neck. Behind him, high in the mist, a veiled goddess's pale hand cradles a small glowing soul. Cold, sorrowful, deadly. Characters: Durzo: a lean half-elf rogue with swept-back silver-white hair and pointed ears, in fitted red-and-black leather armour.

references.role: Character appearance reference for Durzo. Preserve the face, hair, build, colours and outfit shown; ignore the background, base and any interface elements.

request.alt: Durzo stands with daggers drawn in a grey realm of mist while a veiled hand holds a glowing soul above him.
